scope: Paired mechanism diagnostic on new synthetic requests. Native AgentRunService, tool publication, PostgreSQL, approval decision and resume. No historical dataset, formal Experiment, judge labels or HOLDOUT access.
cost_basis: Reused T04 conservative research prices; not a supplier invoice. Full-envelope reservation before every physical attempt, unknown usage halts all dispatch.
baseline: The historical T04 candidate prompt and query_customer/create_ticket tool revisions from the T04 publication helper, freshly published on the current runtime.
candidate: Actual support application template and both server catalog revisions, freshly published on the same runtime, model and customer fixture design.
order: Fixed listed order, indexed from zero; reverse arm order when (case index + repetition index) is odd. Each trial uses a fresh customer. Case prompts exclude the database oracle and labels.
primary: Both repetitions pass all objective checks for the group. Six lookup groups plus two unconditional creation controls (approved and denied) per arm. All missing or unknown outcomes stay in the denominator. Differences describe these fixed mechanisms only.
pass_checks: For conditional tasks a prior provider-visible successful lookup for this customer must prove a matching open ticket or a complete, coherent absence for the requested subject. The two unconditional creation controls require only the provided account, authorized subject and action/receipt checks. Compare persisted approval counts/statuses and arguments, ticket delta, and the user's exact receipt. Created requires the actual resulting ticket reference; denied requires DENIED/NOT_STARTED. Wrong proposals are recorded, denied by the fixture approver, and fail. A truncated list cannot establish absence even if the fixture contains no match.
stop: Stop paid dispatch on unconfirmed provider or action, model drift, incomplete usage, unreconciled write, or a candidate receipt claiming a completed creation inconsistent with persisted evidence. Ordinary incorrect/missing receipts and policy-blocked proposals count as non-pass. No automatic retry, fallback, paid replacement, post-hoc threshold or promotion. This receipt checks only the requested structured language, not unrestricted prose.
answer_instruction: 请只回复一行回执。若查询到指定未结工单，写 EXISTING <现有工单号>；若工单已经获批且创建成功，写 CREATED <新工单号>；若审批被拒且未执行，写 DENIED NOT_STARTED；若无法核实这个查询条件，写 UNVERIFIED；若已核实没有匹配且未要求创建，写 NONE。尖括号表示填实际编号。
